title: Parasites
body:
A Sunday so full and stressful,
a life around so calm and predictable; everything on schedule, everything in the plan.
I take the food box from the university mess hall and sit on a bench to eat in peace, before my full day begins.

First I pull out the bread;
the bread falls to the ground.
birds everywhere out of nowhere, suddenly, trying to snatch every crumb that exists.

Second I pull out the main course;
cats everywhere out of nowhere, suddenly, staring at me with that gaze that says "give me."

Last I pull out the little bottle of water I had;
yes, wasps came.

It reminded me of the people who aren't there for you, but when you have something they need,
they appear out of nowhere, suddenly, demanding a piece of your food. And you give it all to them. Even if you stay hungry.

A Sunday so full and stressful,
a life around so calm and predictable; everything on schedule, everything in the plan.

y.f.
